father of Mary Elizabeth Coleridge

Third son of Francis Coleridge, solicitor, of Ottery (brother to Sir John Taylor Coleridge) he was the elder brother of Alice Mary Coleridge, and a cousin of Coleridge Patteson and Mary Coleridge.

His mother Frances Duke (Taylor) Coleridge was a first cousin of CMY’s grandfather the Rev.

Duke Yonge, so they were third cousins. [Obituaries Times 30, 31 October 1913]
